title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35804v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. translated_title: 学习何时提交：面向快速扩散语言模型的调度蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型可以并行生成多个token，但通常需要多轮解码才能完成一个回复。高效的生成不仅取决于哪些token容易预测，还取决于提交这些token如何帮助预测剩余的位置。一个高度可预测的token可能提供的有用上下文很少，而揭示一个较难预测的token反而可以让其他多个位置更快地变得可预测。我们提出了dSpark，这是一个新的基于调度蒸馏的框架，用于学习何时提交token以实现更快的扩散语言生成。为实现这一目标，我们构建了解除掩码的调度，优先处理那些被揭示后能使其他位置更容易预测的token，从而在解码早期降低不确定性。然后我们将这些调度蒸馏到模型中，以实现更快的并行采样，并通过KL散度正则化器帮助保持生成质量。我们对该方法进行了广泛的评估。
tldr: 提出dSpark框架，通过调度蒸馏学习何时提交token——优先揭示那些能让其他位置更易预测的token，从而在保持生成质量的同时大幅加速扩散大语言模型的并行生成。
en_tdlr: dSpark, a schedule distillation framework that learns when to commit tokens by prioritizing tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, enabling faster parallel generation in diffusion language models while preserving quality.
